content.short: Nad.fun is a Monad memecoin launchpad with fair-launch bonding curves that graduate to a DEX.
content.description: Nad.fun launches tokens on a bonding curve that moves liquidity to a DEX once a threshold is reached, the pattern established by pump.fun and now standard on most new chains. The fair-launch framing refers to there being no presale allocation, which removes one specific failure mode without addressing the others.
content.meta: Fair-launch bonding curves on Monad that move liquidity to a DEX once a threshold is hit.
